validation_rules: the result binds the accepted build-plan attempt and sha256
every successful unit names an immutable image_build_* image id and image-id digest
the caller-owned B13 result sha256 is outside adapter logs and every trial re-verifies against it
the target mount is read-only, only /scratch is writable, and the trial has network none
compile_commands.json is non-empty, names only files in /scratch/src, and every compiler is the fixed clang path
the build lock and host-local image catalog are validated on every read
